We recently joined this surgery after being with Hall Green GP for four years, and it’s honestly like night and day. It had become almost impossible to get an appointment at our old GP, so we decided to change, and it’s been the best decision we’ve made.

We’re now able to get same-day appointments with ease, which has made such a difference. I’m especially happy that the surgery caters well to the South Asian community. My mother doesn’t speak English very well, so it’s incredibly helpful that the staff can communicate with her properly.

The doctors don’t rush you and really take their time. Dr Kamran is also great and has a lovely sense of humour. All the doctors we’ve seen are very knowledgeable and actually prescribe effective treatment, unlike our previous GP where it felt like we were never given anything helpful.

My brother had a head infection for years that our old GP couldn’t resolve. This new surgery prescribed new creams that finally cleared the issue, which we’re so grateful for.
The receptionists are also fantastic friendly, polite, and pleasant to speak to. They’re not moody or dismissive like at some other surgeries.

It’s only been about a month since we joined, but so far the experience has been excellent. We really hope the surgery continues providing this high level of care.

Thank you! 😊",null,[0,237]]]],[null,1771706533000000,1771706533000000,"3 weeks ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/13507324179782832003/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhrY2t4VlNYaGhhbXhvVjFWT1MySkVXa1ZqTUhNellXdzVlVmRYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/13507324179782832003/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhrY2t4VlNYaGhhbXhvVjFWT1MySkVXa1ZqTUhNellXdzVlVmRYWXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/13507324179782832003/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhrY2t4VlNYaGhhbXhvVjFWT1MySkVXa1ZqTUhNellXdzVlVmRYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/13507324179782832003/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhrY2t4VlNYaGhhbXhvVjFWT1MySkVXa1ZqTUhNellXdzVlVmRYWXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/13507324179782832003/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhrY2t4VlNYaGhhbXhvVjFWT1MySkVXa1ZqTUhNellXdzVlVmRYWXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/13507324179782832003/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnhrY2t4VlNYaGhhbXhvVjFWT1MySkVXa1ZqTUhNellXdzVlVmRYWXhBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Thank you for your very thoughtful and kind words.
